purpose: BetterFlash logo exploration for user selection

concepts.name: 01 / BF ligature
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: BetterFlash logo concept for a professional educational flashcard and spaced-repetition application.
Style: polished identity design, sleek, modern, precise, educational, original geometry, flat vector-like raster artwork. Strong compact silhouette, balanced negative space, readable as a small desktop toolbar mark.
Presentation: one square 1024x1024 brand specimen, absolutely flat solid deep aubergine background #211722, monochrome warm ivory #f7eee8 artwork. Center one large logo mark, approximately 280 pixels wide, around x512 y425. Beneath it at y665 place the wordmark "BetterFlash" exactly, in refined IBM Plex Mono-like medium-weight monospace lettering, carefully spaced, about 46px. Spacious margins. At upper left x70 y70, a discreet small monospaced specimen caption specified below. No other text.
Constraints: a custom brand mark, not a generic toolbar action. No overlapping rectangles, no copy/paste symbol, no stacked-paper icon. No brain clip art, graduation cap, lightning bolt, sparkles, eye, face, target, fish, chat bubbles, circuits, arrows or infinity symbol. No gradients, shadows, glow, texture, mockups, perspective, border frame or watermark. The wordmark and caption must be spelled exactly.
Specimen caption (verbatim): "01 / BF ligature".
Design direction: Create an elegant compact uppercase BF ligature, with the B legible on the left and the F legible on the right. Both letters share a carefully constructed typographic rhythm and a joined central stroke. Use moderately bold rounded geometric stems, open generous counters, subtly squared curves, and precise optical spacing. The two letters should integrate into one memorable symbol while remaining clearly readable as BF. The result should feel like the publisher's mark of a contemporary learning instrument, substantial and calm.

Specimen caption (verbatim): "03 / BF editorial".
Design direction: Create a compact custom uppercase BF monogram with an editorial, technical learning character. Use decisive rectilinear letter construction inspired by carefully typeset index labels and instrument lettering, with broad straight stems, a tiny chamfer at external corners, and broad open negative-space counters. This should be an angular typographic seal with no enclosing box, no rounded bubble lettering, no beveling, no stripes and no decorative extras. Optically balance the two letters into a square-ish silhouette.

Specimen caption (verbatim): "04 / Recall fold".
Design direction: Create an original abstract symbol from one broad outlined strip folded into a compact upright bookmark. The silhouette has an open V-shaped notch at its lower end and a single deliberate diagonal fold across its upper third, suggesting a saved idea being revisited. The fold is communicated solely by two clean joining planar contours and negative space, not shading. Give the upper left edge a subtle open turn that makes the form distinctive. It should convey study, retention and returning to knowledge. Simple, balanced, architectural linework, no letters inside, no rectangular card enclosure, no paper stack. Not a ribbon award, not a location pin.
